full_text:
Carapace Armor

Introduction. Carapace Armor is a Mistlands-tier armor. This set is the tier above Padded Armor and is replaced by Flametal Armor, the Ask Set, and the Embla Set.

Armor pieces. This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the Black forge.

Notes. • At its lowest level, Carapace Armor has identical stats to Padded Armor at max level, except for in durability, where Padded armor has more.
